items.name: Unified Reporting Monthly Callouts
items.desc: Upload a single unified report with all your brands selected to generate monthly callouts highlighting brand metrics and strategy. Includes a wasted spend miner to negate token terms from campaigns to prevent wasted spend.
items.author: Ricky G.

items.name: DSP Media Plan
items.desc: A DSP media planning tool that predicts end-of-month spend for each line item and helps you allocate next month's budgets, then generates a ready-to-paste output for Amazon's AI ads chatbot to automatically update your projected spends.
items.author: Ricky G.

items.name: Daypart Analyzer
items.desc: Analyze your Amazon Ads performance by hour and day of week to find the best bid adjustment windows and cut spend during low-converting time slots.
items.author: Hunter G.

items.name: WoW Dashboard
items.desc: A week-over-week performance comparison dashboard that analyzes campaign, product, and search term data across four report types — campaign reports, advertised product reports, business reports, and search query performance — highlighting WoW or MoM changes across revenue, spend, ROAS, CVR, and conversion metrics at the campaign, portfolio, and ASIN level.
items.author: Ricky G.

items.name: Wasted Spend Miner
items.desc: A negative mining tool that analyzes your search term reports to surface wasted spend, score and rank negation candidates across auto, phrase, and broad campaigns, and identify high-value converting search terms you aren't explicitly targeting.
items.author: Ricky G.

items.name: CAC/Movement MoM
items.desc: A browser-based analytics tool for Amazon new-to-brand (NTB) campaign data: upload two months of AMC campaign reports to see month-over-month movement in spend, CAC, NTB sales, and ROAS — broken out by channel (PPC/DSP/Others) and category — plus a Sponsored Products deep-dive page that drills from each campaign down to its individual targets.
items.author: Jamie G.

items.name: SQP MoM View
items.desc: View changes in impression, click, and purchase share against changing search volume across a month-over-month dashboard. Upload your own brands with historical SQP data to access and save the changes by pushing them to GitHub.
items.author: Ricky G.
